exposure: Rural hospital volume category R3 (1700+ deliveries per year)
Hospital volume category 4 (3600+ deliveries per year)
Hospital volume category 1 (50-1199 deliveries per year)
Hospital volume category 2 (1200-2399 deliveries per year)
Hospital volume category 3 (2400-3599 deliveries per year)
Rural hospital volume category R1 (50-599 deliveries per year)
Rural hospital volume category R2 (600-1699 deliveries per year)
cohort: Women who had a term singleton, non-low-birthweight live birth in California between 2007 and 2008 (n=736,643)
finding: There were higher rates of postpartum haemorrhage in the lowest volume rural hospitals, but other maternal outcomes did not differ between hospital volume categories.
